_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). A name and a one-line flavour for each fighter's six energy techniques (light volley, medium lob, heavy technique, energy grab, mine or trap, chargeable beam), with an alternate name for Orb, and three call-outs a fighter (grab, a half-charge beam release, a full-charge release). Orb's brief: docs/ep/vision.md, 'Energy attacks overhaul'. PROVISIONAL: tied to the six slots from Orb's words and to each fighter's identity, not yet to Combat's one-pagers (docs/combat/pending/energy/) or Game Design's system, which had not landed when this was written. Names follow the place-plus-verb default, never a franchise echo; flavour and call-outs are in the fighter's voice (voice bibles) and pass the lint. Claude-written; unmarked by Orb; unscreened by Legal.

medium.label: Medium lob
medium.means: a more substantial explosive blast, lobbed

grab.label: Energy grab
grab.means: a unique catch: net, ring, snare, hook

trap.label: Mine or trap
trap.means: left behind when a block meets an energy attack

light.name: Knuckle Flick
light.flavour: Quick sparks off my knuckles. Catch!

medium.name: Pier Lob
medium.flavour: A big warm lump, thrown high. Duck!

heavy.name: Whole Palm
heavy.flavour: Everything in one open hand. Brace yourself!

grab.name: Harbour Net
grab.flavour: I throw a net. Stay still, please!

trap.name: Warm Patch
trap.flavour: Block, and the ground stays hot. Mind your feet!

beam.name: Open Reach
beam.flavour: Charge it slow. Let it fly far!

light.name: Pin Volley
light.flavour: Thin needles, one after another. Count them.

medium.name: Stair Drop
medium.flavour: One step down. Right on your head.

heavy.name: Rank Breaker
heavy.flavour: This one sorts the amateurs from the rest.

beam.name: Straight Edge
beam.flavour: A clean cut. No wasted motion.

light.name: Silk Sparks
light.flavour: Pretty little sparks, rat. Do try to keep up!

medium.name: Throne Toss
medium.flavour: Gahaha! We toss a crown. You catch it!

heavy.name: Throne Quake
heavy.flavour: The ground bows when we stamp. Hahaha!

grab.name: Banner Snare
grab.flavour: Our banners wrap, rat, and they never let go.

trap.name: Carpet Snap
trap.flavour: Step on our carpet and it bites back!

beam.name: Crown Line
beam.flavour: A line from the crown. It cuts everything!

light.name: Rivet Spray
light.flavour: Spitting hot rivets! Small bites, big hunger!

medium.name: Slag Lob
medium.flavour: Lump of hot slag, thrown with love!

heavy.name: Wrecker Swing
heavy.flavour: Chassis swings, wreckage flies. Duck, snack!

grab.name: Crane Hook
grab.flavour: Hook's out! Come to the yard, snack!

trap.name: Scrap Charge
trap.flavour: Block, and the scrap behind me is wired.

PROTAGONIST.text: All of it! Catch this one!
